lectures.title: Picking Locations via a Click on the Map

cues.en: With the map being there, let's make sure the user can tap it to add new locations and for that here,
let's add an event listener with add listener on the map, so not on Google Maps event, so we're not
registering such a global event so to say but on the map which we created, you can call add listener
and add a click listener there and then this will give you an event object which you can use in that
function that gets fired upon that click.
So this is the function that will get executed on the click and we'll get an event object that holds
useful information, like the coordinates.
So on that click, I'll create a new coords or selectedCoords constant here which will be a Javascript
object and that object will have a latitude and you can name this however you want
by the way, I'll stick lat and lng here but this is now just data
I define not data
Google gives me, so we can name this however you want.
And on lat here, we can store event and then there is a latLng, so one word, latLng property which has
a lat method that will give you the latitude coordinates of that event, so of that click event
and in case you're wondering how I know all of that, well I mentioned that SDK documentation here,
right,
so that is the place where you can learn all of that.
So that gives us the latitude,
now the longitude is received in the same way, on event,
latLng.lng as a method.
Now this gives us coordinates and now we can close the modal here with dismiss and pass on these selected
coordinates as data let's say because in the end, it is that coordinates set that we're interested in
when the user taps the map.

so on

when we listen to the modal to be dismissed. So this data thing here should be our coordinates
